about: The tractus of the formulary “Second Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever. Who shall declare the powers of the Lord, or make all His praises to be heard? Blessed are they that keep judgment and do justice at all times. Remember us, O Lord, in Thy favor toward Thy people; visit us with Thy salvation.

ex.w004: The adjective is the predicate of an understood subject, the Lord, with the verb left out: “for [He is] good”.
